summary: Docebo Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing a Notice of Annual General Meeting and Management Information Circular for a meeting scheduled on June 9, 2026. The filing includes standard proxy solicitation and voting procedures, election of directors, and other routine matters. No special situation such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is indicated. The document is a regular shareholder meeting notice, not a forced management change or other event-driven filing, mapping to the U.S. equivalent of a proxy statement for an annual meeting.
